title: Hex key stand
summary: table-driven sockets, embossed text, print checks
description: A stepped desk stand for a metric hex key set to ISO 2936, 1.5 to 10 mm, printed in PLA without supports, sizes embossed in black.

difficulty.rationale: A table drives every formula, nine hexagons and labels come from it, a 32-edge rim fillet needed careful edge naming; no freeform, no multi-body booleans.

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: document.check ok, its own 5 assertions pass; stand volume 126 544.836 mm3 and section 4344.4085 mm2, equal to this example's; mass 156.99 g; about 100 commands in 14 CLI calls. Its wall check was first not proven over the chamfered and filleted edges (F-020) and passed when restricted to the socket faces.
